profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Optum
profile.summary: Full Stack Software Engineer and AI Developer with 5+ years of experience building enterprise-scale microservices, cloud infrastructure, and AI solutions at Optum (UnitedHealth Group). Proven track record delivering full-stack applications, Agentic AI systems, RAG pipelines, and LLM-powered applications using Azure, Python, Java, and modern frontend frameworks. Experienced leading cross-functional development teams and translating complex business requirements into high-impact, scalable technical deliverables.
